description: This file contains functions and commands related to managing authentication order profiles for agents, including retrieving, setting, and clearing auth profile orders, with dependencies on agent configuration, runtime environment, and profile storage.

methods.name: resolveTargetAgent
methods.description: Resolves the agent ID and directory based on configuration and optional raw input.

methods.name: describeOrder
methods.description: Returns the authentication profile order for a given provider from the store.

methods.name: resolveAuthOrderContext
methods.description: Resolves context including configuration, agent ID, directory, and provider based on options and runtime.

methods.name: modelsAuthOrderGetCommand
methods.description: Retrieves and logs the current auth profile order for a specified provider and agent.

methods.name: modelsAuthOrderClearCommand
methods.description: Clears the auth profile order override for a specified provider and agent.

methods.name: modelsAuthOrderSetCommand
methods.description: Sets a new auth profile order for a specified provider and agent after validation.
